insights.summary: The agent successfully identified and replicated a complex kernel-level optimization by leveraging git history. It demonstrated strong technical understanding of the codebase but failed on administrative constraints (modifying disallowed files) and hit the turn limit before final verification.
strengths: Excellent use of git tools to understand task context.
Strong understanding of CUDA/CUTLASS version requirements.
weaknesses: Poor management of worktree state leading to constraint violations.
Inefficient use of turns (spent too long on benchmark script creation).
Failed to finish within the turn limit.
